reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Co-facilitating the UN Global Dialogue
themes.definition: The speaker country's role in leading or co-facilitating the UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance and the message it promoted there.
themes.inclusion: Include references to leading, co-chairing or participating in UN AI governance processes.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general UN reform demands without AI content.
themes.boundary_cases: Statements on what AI 'must' do made within the Dialogue context may also be coded with the substantive theme (e.g. AI_DEVELOPMENT_SDGS).

examples.quote: Heading up alongside Estonia, the Global Dialogue on Artificial Intelligence Governance

themes.label: AI expanding capacities and competitiveness
themes.definition: AI framed as a tool to expand capacities, create opportunities and build competitive economies.
themes.inclusion: Include statements that AI should expand capacities, create opportunities or competitiveness.
themes.boundary_cases: Competitiveness framed nationally may overlap with AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY.

examples.quote: this technology must expand capacities and create opportunities to build environments that can be competitive in the future

themes.label: Training youth for superintelligence economy
themes.definition: National ambition to join the technological transformation by training young people in superintelligence, robotics and data science.
themes.inclusion: Include plans or aims to train youth or workforce for AI and related technologies.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general education reform without technology link.
themes.boundary_cases: Investment-attraction pitches naming technology are coded here only if skills/training is explicit.

examples.quote: We want to train young people for super intelligence, for robotics, for data science
Colombia does not want to watch the technological transformation of our time from the sidelines.

value.rationale: Both 2026 Latin American passages give AI brief, opportunity-oriented treatment: El Salvador via its co-leadership of the UN Global Dialogue, Colombia via training youth for a superintelligence-era economy.
